note: Pull-request CI runtime budget (#632). Budget is wall-clock seconds of the critical path across PR-gating workflows, measured from GitHub Actions job timing (completed_at - started_at). This is not billed runner minutes. Included workflows are always-on PR-gating workflows; advisory, path-filtered, scheduled, manual, and release workflows are explicitly excluded with reasons. Update this file only with a fresh measurement named in the commit body; never lower coverage or remove a check to fit the budget.
measurement: Initial conservative ceiling set 2026-11-25 from observed PR workflow wall-clock durations. Refresh via cost-report and update with evidence in commit body.
